tool: CUA in-app browser with actual page controls and web Worker

rows.name: extraction and redaction example
global last capture
rows.source: set n [regexp -all -indices {(a)(b?)} aba m a b];list $n $m $a $b

rows.name: unmatched variables
rows.source: regexp z abc m a b;list $m $a $b

rows.name: literal optimization
rows.source: list [regsub -all {} abc X] [regsub -all {()} abc X] [regsub -all -expanded {a b} {a b} X]

rows.name: ordered partial assignment
rows.source: set scalar 0;set m OLD;set tail OLD;catch {regexp {(a)} a m scalar(x) tail};list $m $scalar $tail

rows.name: compile error with output
rows.source: set touched kept;puts before;regsub {(} abc X

actual.error: Invalid("couldn't compile regular expression pattern: parentheses () not balanced")

rows.nativeResult: couldn't compile regular expression pattern: parentheses () not balanced

rows.name: reset removes variables
rows.source: list [info exists touched] [info exists totals] [info exists redacted]

scope: Rendered result/stdout/error/reset text observed after every UI action, then independently checked against native Tcl. Import/download, cancellation/timeout, mobile layout and console logs were not rerun.
